other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent drops ID columns from the test dataset and uses a naive generated sequence (np.arange) for the submission file IDs. If the evaluation system expects the specific IDs from the test set, the submission will be misaligned or fail entirely.

summary: The agent provides a remarkably robust solution that correctly fits imputation on the training split, uses early stopping on a validation set, and follows best practices by refitting on the full dataset with the optimal iterations. However, it applies a cardinality filter before the internal split (minor leak), evaluates the model on a single split, and critically discards the original test set IDs in favor of an arbitrary sequence for the final predictions.
